prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a bustling shipyard dock where massive steel structures loom against a bright sky. On the left stands a tall crane operator in a yellow hard hat, leaning casually against the railing with one arm crossed. In the center, a young engineer in blue overalls holds a rolled-up blueprint tightly, looking intently at the large cargo ship hull rising behind them. To the right, a foreman in a striped vest points firmly toward the water, directing attention to the ongoing work. Next to the foreman sits a small tabby cat on a wooden crate, grooming its paw with calm indifference. Behind the engineer, a stack of rusted metal barrels creates a textured backdrop, adding industrial grit to the setting. The engineer hands a silver wrench to a mechanic in grease-stained coveralls who stands just beside them, ready to tighten a loose bolt on the nearby machinery. The mechanic looks at the tool with focused determination, preparing for the task ahead. There is no ocean visible in the background, only the dry dock floor and distant warehouse walls. The crane operator watches the exchange from their elevated position, while the tabby cat remains oblivious to the human activity. The foreman continues to gesture, ensuring the workflow proceeds without interruption. The rusted barrels stand silent witness to the daily labor, their surfaces weathered by time and salt air. Each character displays distinct features that define their role within this busy industrial environment, captured with clean lines and expressive details typical of the genre.
